intro.text: Be supposed to — «должен», но не по своей воле, а по правилам, договорённости или чужим ожиданиям. А was supposed to — «должен был, но…».

rules.name: правило, обязанность
rules.example: You're supposed to wear a helmet.

rules.name: ожидание, план
rules.example: The train is supposed to arrive at six.

rules.name: молва
rules.example: This film is supposed to be great.

sections.title: Was supposed to — но не вышло

examples.en: I was supposed to call her, but I forgot.
examples.ru: Я должен был ей позвонить, но забыл.

examples.en: We were supposed to meet at five.
examples.ru: Мы должны были встретиться в пять.

callout.title: Вежливое «нельзя»
callout.text: You're not supposed to park here. Мягче, чем You mustn't park here, но смысл тот же.

intro.text: Be to + глагол — официальная форма: планы, указания, приказы. Её слышно в новостях и инструкциях: The President is to visit Paris.

highlights.text: The President is to visit Paris

rules.name: официальный план
rules.example: The Prime Minister is to meet the press.

rules.name: указание, приказ
rules.example: You are to stay here until I return.

rules.name: в прошлом
rules.example: They were to meet again years later.

practice.en: The President [is to] visit China next month.
practice.ru: Президент посетит Китай в следующем месяце.

practice.en: You [are to] leave your keys at the reception.
The new bridge [is to] open in May.
You [are not to] tell anyone about this.
practice.ru: Ты никому не должен об этом говорить.

intro.text: Самые частые ошибки с be supposed to.

errors.wrong: You supposed to wear a helmet.
errors.right: You're supposed to wear a helmet.

errors.wrong: I am suppose to call her.
errors.right: I am supposed to call her.

errors.wrong: We were supposed meet at five.
errors.right: We were supposed to meet at five.

errors.wrong: We supposed to leave at eight, but we were late.
errors.right: We were supposed to leave at eight, but we were late.

callout.title: Supposed — с -d
callout.text: На слух -d почти пропадает, но пишется всегда: supposed to.

quote.text: Be supposed to — «так положено», а не «я так хочу».
quote.author: правило большого пальца
